# ERP Link

> ERP Link connects online stores with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, helping synchronize products, orders, customers and inventory.

Official website: https://erplink.bizsahla.com/
Contact email: info@bizsahla.com

## Detailed integration resources
- [Integration overview](https://erplink.bizsahla.com/en-us/integrations)

These pages describe configuration choices, workflow considerations and test scenarios. Actual integration behavior depends on the enabled connection settings and permissions.

## Scope
ERP Link's public information covers integrations involving platforms such as Zid, Salla, Shopify and Odoo. Features described on the website include synchronization, field mapping and operation logs.

This file describes public content only. Private dashboards, support tickets, customer records, API endpoints and administrative operations are not public resources.
